01Keep startup coordination separate from healthy warm-up
STATEDStartup

Supply registry grace, heartbeat, authorization polling, readiness polling and old-process termination through policy. Remove the unused startup-timeout member and test knob; progressing warm-up remains unbounded.

15 s grace · 100 ms heartbeat · 10 ms authorization · 20 ms observation · 5 min previous-process termination

02Keep distinct stop, idle and acknowledgement clocks
STATEDShutdown

Require shutdown policy for idle lifetime, controller stop, signal waits and drain acknowledgements. Preserve the half-window bound on forced-stop reserve and the fast acknowledgement poll.

30 min idle · 5 s stop · ≤500 ms force reserve · 500 ms per signal · 250 ms acknowledgement grace / 5 ms poll

03Policy owns both diagnostic storage limits
STATEDDiagnostics

Logger rotation, backup count and queue capacity use diagnostics policy. Disconnected operation traces use its retention and capacity, keeping an effective minimum of one trace; completion retention is a separate mechanism.

10 MiB log · 4 backups · 1,024 queued events · 5 min / 1,024 disconnected traces (minimum 1)
